benchmark_input: corpus assembled from the repository's tracked fixtures: 96 clause units from 17 documents (tests/fixtures/**/*.txt verbatim plus fixture PDFs/DOCX parsed with openreview_cli.parsing); the CUAD corpus under data/legalbenchrag/ is not used
command: uv run python scripts/measure_slm_slots.py --grounding-accuracy --arm local --limit 20 --no-pii --corpus-dir corpus --out results/grounding-accuracy-local.json
notes: Regenerated on the open-issues branch from the assembled tracked-fixture corpus. Model ollama/granite4:3b; arm=local. CI run 37110857197 (slm-measurement.yml, job grounding-accuracy); artifact grounding-accuracy-local.json. Positives and negatives are the harness's built-in classes (the clause's own qualifying sentence plus a narrow meaning-preserving rewrite; negatives = unsupported_claim, hallucination and paraphrased_unsupported). Both positive classes are supported by the clause by construction, so this positive set is easier than a human-labelled one and no real-world false-positive rate may be quoted from it; the negative arm is the signal. Single-sample smoke measurement, not a benchmark: model replies vary run to run. PII: --no-pii: PII stripping was SKIPPED. Raw clause text was sent to the model; the balanced/maximum cloud tiers will refuse these calls. Latency is machine-specific (69 calls, mean 17.387032s). unreadable_answers counts answers the reader could not parse, which is how a reader defect is separated from model hesitation.
